snippet.title: Cash Guns Chaos PS3 Playthrough - Does Anyone Remember This Smash TV Clone ?
snippet.description:
Cash Guns Chaos DLX is a multidirectional shooter for the PlayStation 3 that was released via the PlayStation Store in 2006. It was one of two games available for download when the PlayStation 3 was launched. 

Platform: PlayStation 3

Developer: Daybreak Game Company
Publisher: Daybreak Game Company

Initial Release Date: November 17, 2006
